name: The Tadpole Survivor
blurb: One of the thousands who carried an Absolute tadpole and lived. Cured — mostly — but feared, shunned, and on a reactionary's list. A sorcerer whose strange power may be the parasite's parting gift.
appearance: Hollow-cheeked and watchful, with a faint, unsettling shimmer behind the eyes when their power stirs — the kind of look that empties a tavern bench.
personality: Guarded and dryly funny, used to being the thing people cross the street to avoid. Carries the war's living wound as a daily fact, not a backstory.
